case_study_packaging.headline: SaVida Health captures $412K annual savings and 1.5× ROI in under 7 months with Treya’s strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: SaVida Health’s rapid expansion to 50 outpatient addiction-treatment clinics left procurement scattered across individual locations. Fragmented vendor relationships, non-standard pricing, and limited spend visibility were eroding margins just as private-equity owner Council Capital looked for EBITDA improvement. The company needed a fast, data-driven sourcing initiative to unlock six-figure savings without disrupting critical clinical operations.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A fast-growing outpatient addiction-treatment provider operating 50 clinics had procurement scattered across individual locations. Fragmented vendor relationships, non-standard pricing, and limited spend visibility were eroding margins just as the private equity ownership group focused on operational efficiency and margin improvement. The company needed a fast, data-driven sourcing initiative to unlock six-figure savings without disrupting critical clinical operations.
approach_summary: Mapped and cleansed $5.3M of indirect spend across 10 categories, isolating $4.3M in addressable volume for targeted sourcing waves.
Negotiated the client’s Athenahealth EMR contract, cutting fees from 4.56 % to 3.40 % and securing a three-year rate lock worth $358K annually.
Transitioned office and medical supplies to the Provista GPO, leveraging aggregated tier pricing to deliver an additional $32K in run-rate savings.
Performed a telecom spend analysis across 40+ sites and designed a Comcast managed-services consolidation projected to save $18K per year while improving uptime guarantees.
Benchmarked IT hardware specifications and obtained competitive VAR quotes, setting up a 13 % price reduction once final device standards are approved.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya validated $412,065 in annual run-rate savings—within the upper end of the original $240K–$470K target range—and realized the first $358K within 197 days. The savings translate to a 1.55× return on Treya’s hybrid fee structure, surpassing the 1.2× guarantee. Beyond the dollars, SaVida now has centralized spend visibility, streamlined EMR terms, and a scalable GPO platform to support future growth.
where_we_were_unique: Achieved the largest single savings win—$358K on EMR—in less than six months through deep healthcare IT negotiating expertise.
Leveraged long-standing GPO relationships to unlock multi-category discounts with minimal client effort.
Balanced aggressive cost reduction with clinical continuity, ensuring zero downtime across 50 treatment sites.
Hybrid fee model with a minimum ROI guarantee aligned Treya’s incentives with the client’s value creation goals.
